text:
In many countries, politicians promise to cut immigration in order to defend local workers, and some argue that stricter immigration controls protect jobs. I agree only to a limited extent, since limits may protect some local jobs but can harm the economy as a whole.

To begin with, controls may help certain groups in the short term. Limits can reduce competition for low-skilled work, and they may prevent employers from using cheaper foreign labour to push down wages. A local builder who loses contracts to a lower-paid foreign crew, for example, may feel that rules would safeguard his income. In regions with high unemployment, people understandably want newcomers to be limited until jobs are available, and enforcement of existing laws can stop illegal employment that undermines fair conditions.

However, strict controls can harm the economy in the longer term. Migrants fill shortages in health, farming and technology, spend money and create businesses that employ locals. Hospitals in many countries depend on foreign doctors and nurses, and farms may leave crops unpicked without seasonal workers. Immigrants also pay taxes that support public services for ageing populations. Research generally finds that the effect of immigration on local wages and jobs is small, and that unemployment is caused more by recessions and automation than by newcomers. Targeted rules, such as those that match visas to genuine shortages and enforce labour standards, work better than strict bans. Countries that combine controlled migration with strong training for local workers usually see the best results for employment.

In conclusion, stricter immigration controls protect jobs only to a limited extent, and policies should be selective instead of restrictive so that both workers and the economy benefit.

Dài hạn hại kinh tế: lấp thiếu hụt y tế, nông nghiệp, công nghệ, tiêu dùng, lập doanh nghiệp; bệnh viện phụ thuộc bác sĩ nước ngoài; thuế; nghiên cứu cho thấy ảnh hưởng nhỏ; thất nghiệp do suy thoái và tự động hoá; quy tắc nhắm mục tiêu.
Chỉ bảo vệ ở mức hạn chế; chọn lọc.
